documents.title: Part B  Short Proposal (12 pages max)

sub.label: Title of the proposal
prompts: State the proposal title (max 200 chars, no '< > " &').

sub.label: List of participants
prompts: For the coordinator and each affiliated entity: name + country + role in the project.

sub.label: 1.1 Novelty + breakthrough nature
prompts: Is your innovation deep tech in nature, stemming from cutting-edge scientific or technological advances?
Does it represent a significant improvement in cost or performance vs existing or alternative solutions?
Describe the novelty and disruptive potential of your technology vs the state of the art.
Provide empirical data that demonstrate the novelty and disruptive potential.

sub.label: 1.2 Technology Readiness Level (TRL 5+ validation)
prompts: Has your innovation completed all aspects of TRL 5 (validation in a relevant environment)?
Provide evidence of TRL 5 (or higher) validation  test data, user feedback, regulatory pre-submissions, pilot deployments.

sub.label: 1.3 IP protection + FTO strategy
prompts: Does your innovation have adequate IP protection? Patents granted, patents pending, trade secrets?
What is your intellectual property strategy to enter the target market?
What is your FTO (freedom-to-operate) status?

sub.label: 2.1 Market opportunity
prompts: What and how big is the total market to be addressed by your innovation (TAM/SAM/SOM)?
What is the realistic share of the total market you plan to achieve?
Describe your go-to-market and commercialisation strategy to scale up.
Describe your customer value proposition, partnerships, who your customers are, why they will adopt your solution.

sub.label: 3.1 Team capability
prompts: Does your company have the necessary team in terms of skills and competences to develop the innovation and scale the company?
Describe the key team members and their relevant competencies.
How is the company governed and how do you take decisions?
What are the current skills/competence gaps (including gender balance)?
What is your plan to fill these gaps?

sub.label: 3.2 Risk level of the investment + leverage effect
prompts: Has your company demonstrated early traction with investors?
Is the financing requirement to be internationally competitive significantly higher than the amount that market actors alone can finance?
Describe your investor traction, timing and size of your future financing round.
Explain why you need EIC funding  and why market actors will not commit to fund the full amount alone.

documents.title: Video pitch script (3 min, up to 3 team members)

sections.label: Hook (0:00–0:20)
prompts: 20-second hook: open with the problem in human terms; introduce the team.

sections.label: Problem (0:20–0:50)
prompts: State the unmet need + market size + why existing solutions fall short.

sections.label: Solution + Team (0:50–2:30)
prompts: Show the technology + TRL evidence + IP + early traction; introduce 2–3 team members.

sections.label: Why EIC (2:30–3:00)
prompts: 30-second close: why EIC funding is necessary; what catalyses it; the call to action.
